title: Pink Flag
notes:
Harvest labels, dark green and lime, with small EMI logo to the left.
Includes a thick inner sleeve with rounded corners and printed lyrics.

Recorded at Advision Studios.

Catalog # SHSP 4076 appears on spine, back cover, and labels.
Catalog # 0C 062-06 564 on back cover.
Catalog # SHSP 4076(I) on inner sleeve.

Made and printed in Great Britain.

© 1977 Wire
℗ 1977 EMI Records Ltd.

Side A runouts are stamped/etched, side B runouts stamped, except side B variant  7.
